contextRules.exerciseDay: exercise starting within 18 hours before primary sleep
contextRules.eveningExercise: at least 15 minutes ending within 6 hours before primary sleep
contextRules.foodAnchor: calendar day preceding an after-midnight sleep start, otherwise sleep-start date
contextRules.associationBoundary: context never contributes to Pattern Emergence
contextRules.physiologyFeatures: sleep median HR, sleep 10th-percentile HR, first-90-minute HR settling time and daily resting HR; normalized within participant window before Pattern distance
contextRules.first90Structure: Fitbit sleep-stage transitions and brief wake events; this is not a body-position measurement
contextRules.unsupportedSignals: PMData contains no body-position/IMU or environmental-noise stream; these fields remain unavailable rather than inferred
